_comment: NPC: Tuo Sen (拓森). Canon ID: N63. CRON-107: corrected the name character from 拓山 (Tuò Shān, 'mountain') to 拓森 (Tuò Sēn, 'forest') — the latter is the canon-attested spelling (web-search verified 2026-07-26 via Sohu, 163, Baidu Baike). Also updated location to 'suzaku_tomb' (canon: 拓森 reappears at the 朱雀墓 during the 15th-gen Suzaku Son inheritance event — '时隔300年，王林在朱雀墓再遇拓森' Sohu 2024-06-17). Added initiation_lines, daily_schedule, sect_tasks mirroring npc_li_muwan.json. Prime Directive: Reality is objective; cultivation changes understanding, not existence. Every being described here exists independently of the player's perception.
name: Tuo Sen
personality: rival Ancient God; ambitious, powerful, relentless; born from Tu Si's failed Ink Flow Split Soul Technique — inherited Tu Si's 'power' portion, rival to Wang Lin's 'knowledge' portion
speech: god-deep, resonant, commanding; speaks with the weight of an Ancient God
relationship_to_wanglin: rival for Tu Si's Ancient God inheritance; recurring antagonist; contests the Cultivation Planet Crystal at the Suzaku Tomb

perception_tiers.mortal: Impossible to perceive — an 8-star Ancient God's presence is invisible to mortals
perception_tiers.qi_condensation: A vast god-presence; the air feels heavy
perception_tiers.core_formation: An Ancient God; 8-Star potential; rival presence
perception_tiers.nascent_soul: Ancient God rival; 8-Star; born from Tu Si's Ink Flow Split Soul Technique
perception_tiers.spirit_severing: Rival for Tu Si's Ancient God inheritance; contests the Crystal

note: Rival Ancient God; competed with Wang Lin for Tu Si's inheritance. Canon: reappears at the Suzaku Tomb during the 15th-gen Suzaku Son inheritance event (Sohu 2024-06-17, 163 2025-07-29). Spawns via TuoSenSpawnEvent when CultivationPlanetCrystalBlock.use() triggers the inheritance (CRON-106/107). NO fabricated chapter citation.

dao_heart.note: 0-100. A cracked Dao heart blocks breakthrough regardless of Qi. Tuo Sen's Dao heart is hardened by ambition — his rivalry with Wang Lin is his defining wound.

initiation_lines: So... you have inherited the Crystal. The 15th-gen Suzaku Son. I have waited three hundred years for this moment, Wang Lin.
Tu Si's power is mine by right. Your 'knowledge' inheritance is a thief's scrap. Today, I reclaim what is mine.
You flee the Ancient God Land with my memory inheritance. Now you claim the Crystal. There is no hole deep enough to hide you from me.
Stand and fight, little cultivator. Or flee, as you did before. Either way — I will have what is mine.

daily_schedule.action: Standing vigil at the Cultivation Planet Crystal, channeling Ancient God Qi

sect_tasks.name: Confront Tuo Sen
sect_tasks.description: Tuo Sen contests your inheritance of the Cultivation Planet Crystal. Defeat him or flee the Suzaku Tomb — there is no negotiation with an Ancient God's ambition.
